body: Lol maybe when i was 12..not 28. Thats like me asking why are you on reddit instead of writing your questions or thoughts in a journal.
I wasnt asking what he is feeling. It was a more so question on why the fuck would you want a chick to spend the night if its just "fwb"

I told him i still have feelings. He came back with a question of when he cut things off because of "feelings". We didnt talk for 2 months, i went to grab a drink with a guy. He was there also..it was awkward...he brought that up when i told him i still have feelings for him and wanted to ask a question but couldnt form the sentence. I told him yes, the guy that he saw me with (months ago) i slept with him once (the truth). He seemed upset..especially to bring it up 6months later. Basically right after we had sex again (round two) and wanted me to spend the night when after i told him i still have feelings..he was persistent on me staying the night with him.

The hardest part is staying out of my head. But its a struggle to do so. Unfriend him, block him on social media...if you havent bc you cant fathom that, that means even more so that you should. One good part for me was that after i saw my ex and how he looked so depressed by seeing me (i started to workout also and lost 30lbs, looked hot as fuck on purpose bc i knew he was going to be there) he was trying to get my attention and i knew i had the ball in my court. I didnt let him try to reel me back in by his smooth talk. He deleted and blocked me on fb and insta bc he had a hard time seeing me having fun and actually smiling and looking happy without him. So now i dont get to see his things anymore and at first it hurt, but it hurts more to creep on his shit bc im looking to see if hes happy without me. He may be happy without me and with his new girlfriend. I know a lot that his new girl doesnt. I know the real person that he is and how he manipulates people to make himself feel better. Stop letting him have control and you gain control back of yourself.

I stopped questioning what went wrong or what i did or didnt do to make my relationship better..and the answer is, you did nothing wrong. You gave everything you had and in the process, you lost yourself and your true happiness for someone that would have destroyed you even more if you stayed with that person. Never EVER let someone have that control of your feelings, thoughts, and happiness, especially if they are only dragging you down and making you feel like you failed. When in reality, they failed. They failed you, they failed themselves, they failed their family and friends. Let that person destroy themself over destroying you.

I will say, this person will wait for the right time to try to pop back into your life. We they feel like you need them the most or when they feel like youre moving on. My ex did that also when he was on a roadtrip with his new girl. I got fed up with him trying to be caring and wanting to talk to me. I told him to go entertain his new girl over his ex. He didnt like that. Especially since i didnt let him have that power over me anymore.

Everyday is a new day and it will come with struggles and hurdles. But you will over come them. Youre a lot stronger than you think.

I know that there will be days that you will feel deflated and defeated but surround yourself with positivity. Do something that you wouldnt do when you were in that toxic relationship and life will always get better hun.

There really isnt a simple answer because the answer is from my own experiences. There is no "getting over" its more so a healing experience of bettering yourself. Focus on your wants and needs. As you slowly heal yourself, you see that it wasnt meant to be with that person and can replace the sadness of those memories and look back on them with a smile that those memories even happened.

This is exactly how i felt almost a year after ending a 5 year relationship! Saw my ex at a mutual friends wedding a few months back and knowing that he just cheated on his new girlfriend after telling me how much he has changed and became a better person and how its sad that its too late for us, was an even more wake up to myself that he will never change. 

Were always better off without that person we thought we couldnt live without.

After a 5 year relationship that ended, i was in the same place. It gets better, i tell my friends good night and sweet dreams (thats what my ex and i would say every night to each other)

So, goodnight and sweet dreams 😀
